You can't walk between the 2 terminals. Take the free inter-terminal shuttle bus, or ride the AREX airport railroad a single stop.
Which terminal you use depends on your airline; Korean Air and some others use Terminal 2. Always check the terminal for your return flight on your ticket.
The shuttle bus and the AREX airport railroad run less often late at night, so leave plenty of time if you're moving between terminals late.

jongno-to-gmp-taxi.desc: Taxi from Jongno/Insadong to Gimpo Airport: meter estimates from the Gyeongbokgung area, late-night surcharge tips and a flat-rate option. 19.9km, about 27 min.
jongno-to-gmp-taxi.h1: Taxi Fares and Time from Jongno/Insadong to Gimpo Airport
jongno-to-gmp-taxi.lead: Thinking of taking a taxi from Jongno/Insadong to Gimpo Airport? Here are typical meter fares for the Gyeongbokgung area of Jongno/Insadong, what to know about the late-night surcharge, and how a flat-rate transfer compares.
box: KRW 80,000 (1 vehicle, flat rate), same price late at night and early morning
secs: Typical Taxi Fares from Jongno/Insadong to Gimpo Airport

Measured from Insadong, the road distance to the International Terminal is 19.9km. The route between Gimpo Airport and Jongno/Insadong is mostly city roads, so the taxi fare is much lower than from Incheon Airport. A regular taxi between Jongno/Insadong and the airport typically runs about KRW 21,000–26,000 on the meter (estimated from fares and road distance as of November 2026).
From 22:00 to 4:00, a late-night surcharge applies (20–40% depending on the hour). Insadong shops close early in the evening, and taxis are easier to catch out on Jongno's main road.
Kuma Travel's transfer is a flat KRW 80,000, the same late at night, early in the morning and in traffic. Split 4 ways, that's KRW 20,000, per person which can be cheaper than splitting into 2 taxis.
Regular Taxi vs. Flat-Rate Transfer
A regular taxi's trunk is full with about 2 suitcases. For 4 adults with lots of luggage traveling from Jongno/Insadong, you'll need a jumbo taxi or a van transfer.

At Gimpo Airport, the taxi stand is close to the arrivals hall and waits are fairly short. With a transfer, we meet you in your hotel lobby and take you straight to the car. Many alleys in Insadong and Bukchon are closed to cars, so pick-up and drop-off happen on a nearby main road. If you're staying in a hanok, please send us a map pin.
Our Picks by Situation

Late arrival：We take you from the arrivals hall to your Jongno/Insadong hotel with no changes, so you can rest as soon as you get there. Insadong shops close early in the evening, and taxis are easier to catch out on Jongno's main road.
Lots of luggage：Many alleys in Insadong and Bukchon are closed to cars, so pick-up and drop-off happen on a nearby main road. If you're staying in a hanok, please send us a map pin.
Family trips：Even with a stroller or big luggage, we help carry your bags from the Gimpo Airport arrivals hall to the car.
Traveling light：Subway Line 5 runs to Gwanghwamun and Jongno 3-ga with no changes. If you want to save money, the train is best.
Estimated Pick-Up Time by Flight Time

From Gimpo Airport, the route exits on the east side of the airport and heads to Jongno/Insadong via Gangbyeon-buk-ro (north of the Han River) and other roads. Much of the route avoids expressways, so time spent at traffic lights makes a big difference to the trip.
8:00 departure：Leave Jongno/Insadong around 4:20
11:00 departure：Leave Jongno/Insadong around 7:20
14:00 departure：Leave Jongno/Insadong around 10:20
18:00 departure：Leave Jongno/Insadong around 14:20
21:00 departure：Leave Jongno/Insadong around 17:20
Estimates assume arriving at the airport 3 hours before an international flight, with driving calculated at 1.4x to account for traffic.
About the Jongno/Insadong Area

The heart of sightseeing, where traditional Korean streetscapes survive around Gyeongbokgung Palace, Insadong and Bukchon Hanok Village. Places to stay include hanok stays around Insadong and business hotels in Jongno. On sightseeing days, you can also get around by charter: half day (4 hours) KRW 300,000, 1 full day (8 hours) KRW 500,000.
Jongno drop-off：Many alleys in Insadong and Bukchon are closed to cars, so pick-up and drop-off happen on a nearby main road. If you're staying in a hanok, please send us a map pin.

icn-namdaemun-ikikata.h1: Incheon Airport to Namdaemun｜Which Way Is Easiest?
icn-namdaemun-ikikata.lead: Which way gets you from Incheon Airport to Namdaemun without changing? We compare each transport option along the 55.0km road route.
box: KRW 150,000 (1 vehicle, flat rate), same price late at night and early morning
secs: 4 Ways to Get from Incheon Airport to Namdaemun
Train, 1 change：Take the AREX airport railroad to Seoul Station, and Namdaemun Market is within walking distance. By subway, it's 1 stop on Line 4 to Hoehyeon Station.
Limousine bus：Airport limousine buses run from Incheon Airport toward Namdaemun, and you walk from the stop to your hotel. The fare is around KRW 17,000.
Taxi：Board at the stand straight ahead as you exit the arrivals hall. Expect about KRW 58,000–71,000 (estimated from fares as of November 2026, late-night surcharge extra).

Transfer：From the arrivals hall exit to your hotel entrance with no changes, for a flat KRW 150,000 (1 vehicle). Around Namdaemun Market, delivery trucks crowd the streets in the morning, so for early departures it's smoother to board on the main road.
Our Picks by Situation

Late arrival：Many market shops close in the early evening, and the Myeongdong side is brighter and livelier at night. With a transfer, you don't have to worry about the taxi late-night surcharge (20–40%).
Group trips：A Staria fits 6 people plus 4–5 large suitcases. Split 4 ways, that's KRW 37,500 per person.
Kids or seniors：We can provide a child seat free of charge. No changes all the way to the front entrance of your Namdaemun hotel.
Traveling light：Take the AREX airport railroad to Seoul Station, and Namdaemun Market is within walking distance. If you want to save money, the train is best.
Estimated Hotel Arrival by Flight Time

From Incheon Airport, the route crosses the Yeongjong Bridge or Incheon Bridge and enters Seoul via the Incheon International Airport Expressway. For Namdaemun, it usually continues along Gangbyeon-buk-ro (north of the Han River), detouring onto city streets when the riverside road is congested.
9:00 arrival：At your Namdaemun hotel around 11:10
13:00 arrival：At your Namdaemun hotel around 15:10
17:00 arrival：At your Namdaemun hotel around 19:10
21:00 arrival：At your Namdaemun hotel around 23:00
23:00 arrival：At your Namdaemun hotel around 1:00
Estimates allow about 50 min for immigration and baggage claim, and daytime driving is calculated at 1.4x to account for traffic.
About the Namdaemun Area

The area around Namdaemun Market and Sungnyemun Gate, within walking distance of both Myeongdong and Seoul Station. Highlights include Namdaemun Market, Sungnyemun Gate and the Hoehyeon Station area. Nearby areas are Seoul Station (about 0.8km), Myeongdong (about 0.8km) and Euljiro (about 1.5km).
Arrival day：The market's kalguksu alley and braised cutlassfish alley are perfect for dinner on your arrival day.
